stages.report:
SURVIVED
The rule survived falsification tests on the 2020-08-11 to 2026-10-29 window for SOL/USDT. Surviving past tests is not a forecast.

**What was tested**
When SOL/USDT closes above the previous 20-day high with volume at least 1.5x its 20-day average, buy at the next day's open and hold for 10 trading days. Backtest: 70 signals, 36 completed trades, mean net 9.81%, median net 5.21%, win rate 66.7%, total net 723.18%, max drawdown -69.13%, exposure 15.85%, avg bars held 10.0, t_stat 2.16.

**Strongest evidence against**
The rule is infrequent and capital inefficient versus holding. Exposure is 15.85% of the time and buy-and-hold total over the same window is 2799.50% vs rule total net 723.18%. Max drawdown is -69.13%.

**What held up**
Random-entry baseline passed: rule mean 9.81% vs random-entry mean 3.21%; beat 97% of 2000 random sets, one-sided p = 0.029. Sample size pass with 36 completed trades. Look-ahead guard pass. Fee sensitivity pass: mean trade 9.48% at 0.25% per side, edge disappears at about 501 bps per side. Time-split pass: 11.52% n=19 then 7.89% n=17. Nearby parameters pass: 10 of 10 variants point same way median 9.24%. Cross-asset pass: beats random entries on 8 of 9 other assets.

**What would change the verdict**
A p-value above 0.05 vs random entries, failure of fee or time-split tests, or evidence of look-ahead bias would change the verdict.

**Caveats**
Falsify tests beliefs about the past. It is not investment advice and makes no prediction.
